content.short: Blocknative Gas Estimator provides free gas fee quotations for Ethereum and Polygon with EIP-1559 support.
content.description: Blocknative Gas Estimator provides real-time gas fee estimates for Ethereum and Polygon, with full EIP-1559 support. You can view Ethereum gas updates on the tool's website, embed it on your own site via an iframe, or install the provided extension. For developers, the Estimator API enables traders and other users of their DApps to receive accurate, real-time transaction cost estimates that can be integrated into their applications.
